What I Can Do for You

Engineered specifically for short-form retention, viral hooks, and high-conversion creator storytelling.

Short Form & Vertical Video

We craft bite-sized, high-impact edits perfect for capturing attention on platforms like Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok. Our expertise ensures your short-form content is engaging, dynamic, and packs a punch within seconds.

  • Dynamic animated captions with keyword highlights
  • 3-second hook optimization & retention curve preservation
  • SFX soundscaping (whooshes, risers, pop cues)

Algorithm & SEO Optimization

We go beyond the edit! We optimize your video titles, descriptions, and tags to increase discoverability in search results on YouTube and other platforms. This helps your ideal audience find your content more easily.

  • High-CTR thumbnail concepting and A/B test strategy
  • Keyword-dense timestamps and chapter breakdowns
  • Algorithmic metadata and cross-platform tagging

Long-Form Repurposing & Horizontal Video

We transform your podcasts, interviews, and long tutorials into goldmines of vertical content, as well as high-production widescreen YouTube cuts. Seamless multi-cam switching and cinematic audio mastering.

  • Podcasts-to-viral-shorts extraction pipeline
  • Color grading in DaVinci Resolve & multi-cam syncing
  • Studio-grade vocal cleanup & background music mixing

Content Strategy & Retention Consulting

Unsure where to start or need a fresh perspective? We offer personalized consultations to help you brainstorm video ideas, develop a content strategy, and optimize your approach for maximum impact on YouTube and Instagram.

  • Channel audit and viewer retention curve analysis

Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about our editing workflow, turnaround times, and vertical delivery standards.

I have raw footage or a podcast, but I'm not sure what clips will perform best. Can you help? +

Yes! We review your full raw footage or long-form recordings, identify the highest-retention conversational moments, punchlines, and insights, and turn them into viral-ready 9:16 vertical cuts.

How do you optimize edits for vertical platforms (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)? +

Every platform has native UI overlays (like comment icons, audio bars, and account tags). We edit strictly within the 9:16 safety zones, use large centered captions, dynamic zoom cuts, and fast-paced B-roll inserts to maintain visual energy.

Can you also handle horizontal (16:9) YouTube videos when I'm ready? +

Absolutely! Our production pipeline is fully modular. We can deliver both full-length widescreen (16:9) YouTube videos with in-depth chaptering and derive 5-10 vertical short cuts from the exact same master file.

What is your typical turnaround time per cut? +

For short-form vertical reels, turnaround is typically 24 to 48 hours. We deliver review links allowing you to leave exact timestamped feedback.

Ready to get started? How can I contact you? +

You can reach out directly via WhatsApp at (16) 99406-3622 or send an email to Gabriellopes12300@gmail.com. We reply promptly within 24 hours!
